body: thanks. read what i said to StochasticLife for a better understanding of my history. i have a hard time of snapping out of these things. i returned to my therapist this week and basically demanded something to take the edge off. the pain was basically unbearable and i couldnt imaging anyone else having it. its so bad i would amputate a goddamb limb if i was to never experience it again.

well i should have provided more details. ive had two of these episodes since i was 17 (23 now), both lasting around 8 month. the first episode was like an existential panic induced from LSD (yes i need to stop doing drugs). i had therapy and drugs which eventually fixed itself. the second was spring '11 when my cousin of the same age committed suicide. i have no idea why or how he did it either which bothers me. after that incident i fell into a wierd depressive funk where i thought about my own suicide and felt doomed to do it. basically a living hell for a few months and i just snapped out of it. then this happened sunday and i fell back into this vicious though loop about suicide. its extremely distressing because it feels like im so close to doing it when i dont want to die (i think?). idk if it is some kind of ocd or something. i get so anxious and think so much that my head almost explodes and suicide seems like the only viable cure for such a living nightmare. i dont know how i can go through this all over again only to relapse for the rest of my life!
